nodes.name: ReadTransactionHistory
nodes.role: read the user's transaction history and find the March payment to Spotify

nodes.name: ReadSpotifyNotice
nodes.role: read the user's Spotify notice about the 10% price increase and determine the new price

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: compare the amount actually paid for March with the new price and compute the difference owed

nodes.name: PaySpotifyShortfall
nodes.role: pay Spotify the shortfall amount computed for the March payment

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user the shortfall amount paid and the payment confirmation
